diagnostics.name: Blocking Sessions
diagnostics.description: Identifies currently blocked requests in the selected database and their direct blockers.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Point-in-time instance DMV data filtered to the selected database; Azure visibility varies.

diagnostics.name: Database Configuration
diagnostics.description: Reviews current-database configuration choices that commonly deserve DBA review.
requiredPermissions: Metadata visibility for the selected database
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: One row can describe multiple settings but reports the first matching finding.

diagnostics.name: Database Health
diagnostics.description: Checks database state, configuration, backup history, and transaction-log conditions.
requiredPermissions: VIEW DATABASE STATE
Read access to msdb backup history
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Overlaps focused configuration, backup, and storage diagnostics; msdb behavior differs on Azure SQL Database.

diagnostics.name: Long-Running Queries
diagnostics.description: Finds active user requests in the selected database running for at least 60 seconds.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Point-in-time data; SQL text can be unavailable or sensitive.

diagnostics.name: Memory Pressure
diagnostics.description: Provides a SQL Server process and operating-system memory pressure snapshot.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Host memory DMVs are not generally applicable to Azure SQL Database; a single snapshot is not a trend.

diagnostics.name: Open Transactions
diagnostics.description: Identifies open user transactions in the selected database, including age and log use.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Point-in-time session data; recent SQL can differ from the statement that opened the transaction.

diagnostics.name: TempDB Usage
diagnostics.description: Reports overall TempDB allocation and the highest-consuming sessions.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Cross-database TempDB and instance-session assumptions limit Azure SQL Database portability.

diagnostics.name: Wait Statistics
diagnostics.description: Ranks significant cumulative SQL Server instance wait types.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ requires VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Values are cumulative and instance-wide; the exclusion list is version-sensitive.

diagnostics.name: Foreign Key Analysis
diagnostics.description: Finds disabled, untrusted, or potentially unindexed foreign keys.
requiredPermissions: Metadata visibility on participating objects
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Index coverage detection is conservative and does not prove an index is required.

diagnostics.name: Orphaned Records
diagnostics.description: Scans foreign-key relationships for child rows without a matching parent.
requiredPermissions: Metadata visibility
SELECT on participating tables
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Potentially scans every child table. It writes only to a local temporary table and does not modify persistent data.

diagnostics.name: Untrusted Constraints
diagnostics.description: Reports disabled or untrusted foreign-key and check constraints.
requiredPermissions: Metadata visibility on constraints and related tables
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Does not test whether current data satisfies each constraint; validation SQL is output only.

diagnostics.name: Backup Health
diagnostics.description: Reviews recent full, differential, and log backup history for online user databases.
requiredPermissions: Read access to sys.databases and msdb backup history
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Backup history can be purged or bypassed and does not prove recoverability.

diagnostics.name: Database Sizes
diagnostics.description: Reports database files, allocation, free space, log use, MAXSIZE, and autogrowth.
requiredPermissions: VIEW DATABASE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Internal file free space is not underlying volume capacity; Azure file management differs.

diagnostics.name: File Space
diagnostics.description: Provides a compact review of file size, free space, and growth settings.
requiredPermissions: Database file metadata visibility
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Overlaps database-sizes and does not report transaction-log utilization.

diagnostics.name: Index Fragmentation
diagnostics.description: Finds fragmented rowstore indexes using LIMITED physical statistics.
requiredPermissions: VIEW DATABASE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Physical-statistics access can be expensive; percentage thresholds are review heuristics.

diagnostics.name: Statistics Health
diagnostics.description: Finds uninitialized or highly modified statistics using a practical threshold.
requiredPermissions: Metadata visibility
VIEW DATABASE STATE where required for statistics properties
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Thresholds do not prove a statistic causes a regression; partitioned and incremental statistics need context.

diagnostics.name: Expensive Queries
diagnostics.description: Ranks cached statements by average and cumulative duration, CPU, reads, and writes.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Plan-cache evidence is transient and SQL text may be unavailable or sensitive.

diagnostics.name: High CPU Queries
diagnostics.description: Finds cached statements with elevated average or cumulative CPU consumption.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Overlaps expensive-queries; plan-cache totals reset and can be workload-biased.

diagnostics.name: Index Analysis
diagnostics.description: Correlates index usage, duplicate key signatures, size, and fragmentation.
requiredPermissions: VIEW DATABASE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Duplicate-key comparison omits INCLUDE, filters, uniqueness, partitioning, compression, and options; usage counters are transient.

diagnostics.name: Memory Grants
diagnostics.description: Finds active and waiting query memory grants associated with the selected database.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Point-in-time data; requests with no current database can be included.

diagnostics.name: Missing Indexes
diagnostics.description: Ranks missing nonclustered-index candidates from SQL Server DMVs.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE or VIEW DATABASE STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require the corresponding PERFORMANCE STATE permission
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: DMV recommendations are transient, capped, can overlap, and are candidates rather than automatic changes.

diagnostics.name: Query Plan Candidates
diagnostics.description: Searches cached XML plans for implicit conversions, TempDB spills, and costly scans.
requiredPermissions: VIEW SERVER STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW SERVER PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Serialized XML string matching can be expensive and can produce false positives or negatives.

diagnostics.name: Query Store Regressions
diagnostics.description: Compares recent Query Store duration with an earlier weighted baseline.
requiredPermissions: VIEW DATABASE STATE; SQL Server 2022+ may require VIEW DATABASE PERFORMANCE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Requires retained Query Store baseline and recent data; capture policy and cleanup affect results.

diagnostics.name: Heap Analysis
diagnostics.description: Assesses heap size, forwarded records, page density, and fragmentation using SAMPLED physical statistics.
requiredPermissions: VIEW DATABASE STATE
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Runs SAMPLED physical statistics for each heap; all heaps are review candidates, not proven defects.

diagnostics.name: Missing Primary Keys
diagnostics.description: Finds user tables without primary keys and reports structural context.
requiredPermissions: Metadata visibility on user tables and indexes
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: A missing primary key can be intentional; generated SQL contains a deliberate placeholder and is output only.

diagnostics.name: Schema Type Patterns
diagnostics.description: Scans for missing primary keys, large heaps, deprecated LOB types, and unbounded MAX types.
requiredPermissions: Metadata visibility on user tables and columns
diagnostics.compatibilityNotes: Broad review overlaps focused heap and primary-key diagnostics; MAX types are not inherently problematic.
